name: Konstruktsiya
tagline: We design and install steel structures
niche: Design and installation of steel structures: stairs, mezzanines, frames

seo.title: Konstruktsiya — turnkey steel structures in Tashkent
seo.description: Calculations, structural and shop drawings, fabrication and installation: stairs, mezzanines, extension and attic frames for homes and commercial sites.
seo.answer: Konstruktsiya is an engineering company in Chilanzar designing and installing steel structures. Steel-frame stairs from 14,000,000 UZS, mezzanines from 950,000 UZS per m², extension frames from 1,200,000 UZS per m², shop drawings from 2,500,000 UZS. 5-year warranty, phone +998 71 200-04-04.

listing.description: A website for a structural steel engineering firm: drafting graphics, projects with specs, priced services and installation stages.

sections.title: We calculate, draw, weld and install
sections.subtitle: Turnkey stairs, mezzanines and extension frames. Every structure is load-checked first, then drawn up in shop drawings — and only then do we cut steel.

items.title: Steel-frame staircase
items.text: Straight, L- or U-shaped, ready for timber or concrete cladding.

items.title: Mezzanine
items.text: A second level in a warehouse, shop or high-ceilinged flat.

items.title: Extension frame
items.text: Terraces, conservatories and extensions to private houses.

items.title: Structural and shop drawings
items.text: If another contractor will fabricate, we hand over the calculations and drawings.

items.title: Warehouse mezzanine
items.text: A second level for an online store’s racking · Area: 320 m² · Load: 500 kg/m² · Time: 4 weeks

items.title: Staircase in a Chilanzar house
items.text: U-shaped stringer stair for oak cladding · Floors: 3 · Time: 3 weeks

items.title: Attic over a garage
items.text: A light steel frame on existing walls · Area: 64 m² · Time: 5 weeks

items.title: Café terrace
items.text: A summer terrace frame with a sliding roof · Area: 140 m² · Time: 6 weeks

sections.label: Company
sections.title: Engineers who stand on site themselves
sections.text: We have two structural engineers, our own 600 m² workshop and two installation crews. Calculations follow local building codes, and every project comes with a passport of drawings and a hidden-works report — useful for sign-off and for selling the house.

items.title: Measurement
items.text: A craftsman visits with samples, takes measurements and talks through the job. Free within Tashkent.

items.title: Sketch
items.text: We draw a sketch and price the job. We revise it until you like it, at no extra charge.

items.title: Fabrication
items.text: We cut, bend, forge and weld in our own workshop, sending photos at every stage.

items.title: Finishing
items.text: Metal primer plus powder or forge paint, so the finish does not peel after one season.

items.title: Installation
items.text: We deliver and install in a day, clean up after ourselves and sign the warranty.

items.a: Yes — without a load check a mezzanine is unsafe. Calculations and drawings are included if we install it.

items.q: How much is an engineer’s visit?
items.a: Free within Tashkent. The engineer measures, checks the base and gives a preliminary price on the spot.
